text:
Amanda L.: Heads up — we're proposing an RBAC tweak for BYOK/HSM operator roles and need to confirm audit log fidelity for compliance. TL;DR: add a granular operator role, ensure each key action logs key_id, operator_id, operation, and prev_state. Thoughts?

Samir P.: +1. Suggest role 'hsm_key_operator' with no ability to export. Audit must include key material fingerprints and operation context. Also require ephemeral session tokens (OKTA) with session id in logs.

Jordan (sec): Agree. For compliance (SOC2 / PCI scoped customers) we need immutable append-only audit streams. Ship logs to central SIEM (customer if configured) and sign them with our log signing key. Also include request_nonce for replay protection.

Luis M.: Question — how do we handle forwarding to customer KMS? Do we mirror audit events to their SIEM via RFC5424/TLS or S3 bucket push? What about retention and redaction?

Amanda L.: We're planning two options: (1) forward via secure syslog/TLS (RFC5424) to customer endpoint, (2) push encrypted daily bundles to customer-controlled S3 with client-side encryption. Retention configurable per customer in account settings. Need to confirm redaction policy (PII).

Samir P.: For incident response, add a 'break-glass' path but require 2-person approval and record video-proof link in log metadata. Example log fields:

```
{
  'timestamp': '2026-03-20T15:12:33Z',
  'event': 'hsm_key_rewrap',
  'key_id': 'cust-9f2a',
  'operator': 'amanda',
  'operator_role': 'hsm_key_admin',
  'session_id': 'sess-abc123',
  'request_nonce': 'n-0001',
  'result': 'success',
  'audit_signature': 'sig-v1'
}
```

Jordan (sec): Also, add a periodic integrity scan that verifies signatures and looks for missing events. Anything that fails should create an oncall pager. ops-oncall, make an alert runbook.

ops-oncall: noted. I'll stub a runbook and schedule a tabletop drill next Wed. @Jordan (sec) can you own the SIEM-forwarding spec?

Jordan (sec): Yep, I'll draft the spec and link it to SEC-879. security-bot: created ticket SEC-879 and added checklist. :white_check_mark:

security-bot: [auto] ticket SEC-879 created: 'BYOK HSM rbac/audit forwarding spec' — link: https://redwood.internal/SEC-879

Amanda L.: Thanks. Action items: Jordan to spec, Samir to propose exact RBAC policy diff, Luis to validate customer SIEM options. We'll meet Tue 10am to finalize. :rocket:
